# Find out if your business insurance meets your client's contract, and what it quietly excludes.

> Free business insurance policy reader: paste a general liability, professional liability or BOP policy and get the limits, deductible, claims-made trigger and renewal dates (downloadable .ics), whether the limits meet a client's contract requirement, and the exclusions to ask your broker about.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
